tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'on rgyal sras rin po che'i ngor mdzad dam tshig bskang gso'i reg zig dge/ swasti/ dam tshig bskang gso dang gzhan 'dres med pa mdzad na shom yang dam tshig bskang ba'i shom las gzhan yi dam chos srung gi mchod gtor gang yang mi dgos/ bdag bskyed rab kyai rdor rang sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma'i bka' srol yin/ de nyid khyer bde mus chen sems dpa' chen pos mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs bya bral ma dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun gcig ma yin kyang lam 'bras gsan phyin chad rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyi mngon rtogs mdzes rgyan/ lus dkyil mdzes rgyan/ zung 'brel nas lam dus rgyas pa dang / de la gsung rgyun phyag bzhes ltar gyi lam dus 'bring po mdzad dgos kyang re zhig de pa nas kyai rdor bdag bskyed gnang tshe gong zhus mus chen gyi des 'thus pas bkra shis chos sde sogs nas phyag dpe g.yar gnang dgos sam/ phyag na yod tshe ma dgos lags shing / bdag bskyed grub nas liṅga dgug gzhug gi gtor mar sgron/ sbyangs bdug ces byin gyis brlabs pa'i chang ngam bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa'i chang la nang mchod zer bas thog mar des sbyangs/ de nas chu/ de nas chang phal pas sbyangs pa la nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs pa zer/ de ltar dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan sa lugs la ngos dag yod/ spos ni gu gul dang rengs bu bdug spos dkar bdug mi nyan/ de nas mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā lar dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i nyer mchod lngar gyur/ oṃ arghaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke ghandhe/ nai wi dye/ shapta āḥhūm̐/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs la/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā lar dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus pa sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga/ ye shes lnga'i ngo bor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥlan gsum sogs phyag rgya bcas pas byin gyi brlabs/ rten rdo tshom bu bcas bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang du pad nyi dgra bgegs kyi ro steng dbus su hūm̐ las stobs 'phrog dbang po zhal bzhi/

rtsa zhal nag po mi ro gsol ba/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud kha/ spyan gsum khro gnyer sma ra smin ma dbu skra rnams kham nag gyen brdzes/ phyag bzhi'i dang pos thugs kar gri gug thod khrag steng 'og g.yas 'og mas ral gri/ g.yon 'og mas thod skam phreng ba/ mchan khung g.yon na bum pa/ thod skam dbu rgyan mgo rlon dang / dug sbrul do shal rus rgyan drug tshangs sku dril bu g.yer kha'i sil tshom/ stag sham g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gyad kyi dor stabs can gyi phyogs bzhir hūm̐ re las g.yas su g.yung mo nag mo/ g.yon du gtum mo ljang gu/ mdun du srin mo dmar mo/ rgyab tu siṅgha li ser mo rnams gcer bu rgyu ma'i ga shal gri gug 'phyar zhing / thod khrag gtso bo la stobs pa/ g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum gar stabs can la bka' nyan dam can rgya mtshos bskor ba'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas yul nyer bzhi/ gnas so gnyis/ dur khrod brgyad/ khyad par mgon po nyid chags pa'i gnas nas gtso 'khor thams cad oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ 'di'i man ngag spos sam gu gul bsreg rnga rol gdung dbyangs kyis/ hūm̐ lha mchog ma hā ka la zhal bzhi pa/ /yum chen bzhi dang dam can rgya mtshor bcas/ /gar bzhugs gnas nas 'dir byon bdag cag gi /nyams chags skong ba'i dam rdzas bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ ma hā kā la tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wā ra sa ma dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ padma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ rnga rol bzhag rdo rje rtse lnga'i dam rgya bcas la/ sa ma ya sma ra/ sa ma ya ma ti kra ma ti sa ma ya rakṣantu/ sngon gyi dam tshig bzhin bstan 'gro kun dang bdag cag gi phrin las kun mdzod cig rnga rol bcas/ 'jig rten khams kyi dgra bgegs kun/ /bsgral ba'i nyer spyod rnam lnga 'di/ /zhing skyong 'khor bcas zhal dbu sogs/ /mdzes pa'i mchod 'bul bzhes su gsol/ /zhes phyi mchod dang / rnga rol bzhag oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod rnga rol bcas/

sku gsum mngon gyur rnam sprul mtha' yas la/ /rnam gsum bstan 'gro'i don mdzad zhing skyong che/ /dug gsum dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i yum 'khor bcas/ /cho 'phrul gsum ldan rnams la bstod par bgyi/ /rnga rol bzhag gtso gtor sngags thung lan bdun/ sngags ring lan gsum gyis bsngo ba'o/ /yang na sngags thung gnyis sngags ring gcig bcas gsum dang / 'khor gtor la a ka ro nyer gcig gam bdun gyis bsngo/ rnga rol bcas/ dur khrod gnas dang khyad par bsil tshal nas/ /chos skyong 'dir byon phyi nang gsang gsum rten/ /nyams chag bskang phyir bzhes nas bdag cag la/ /mchog thun dngos grub stsol zhig dam tshig can/ /zhes dang / rnga rol mu nas/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' stsal rtsa ltung dang / /yan lag ltung ba nyams kun 'gyod sems kyis/ /snying nas bshags so tshangs par stsal du gsol/ /rgyu bzhi'i sdig sgrib dag par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshar gsum bdun gang rung / de lhag bsags kyang chog rnga rol mu nas/ sdang dgra'i gshed ma zhing skyong 'khor bcas kyi/ /rmad byung yon tan kun la bdag bstod do/ /rnam bzhi'i phrin las mthar phyin sa lam bsgrod/ /rdo rje 'dzin par mdzod cig dpal mgon che/ /rnga rol bzhag gtor kha gsos/ sbyang bdug bsang sbyang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ hūm̐ sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ /gtum po khyod kyis ji ltar khas blangs ltar/ /phrin las rnam bzhi'i las la spyan 'dren na/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ ma hā kā la tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rnga rol bzhag gtso gtor sngags thung gnyis dang sngags ring gcig dang / 'khor gtor a kā ro bdun gyis bsngos/ oṃ arghaṃ sogs gong bzhin phyi mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod/ 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i chos skyong spyi bshags tshar gcig khyed thugs ma gsum/

rnga rol bcas/ gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i bskang ba lha mchog ma/ yang gtor kha gsos/ sbyang bdug bsang sbyang / byin brlabs/ spyan 'dren/ 'bul sngags/ phyi nang mchod pa/ bshags pa tshigs lhug lha mchog ma'i bskang ba ste de 'dra tshar bdun rigs 'gre/ de nas gnyen gyi mdzad pa'i phyag mtshan 'bul tshig stobs chen shug drag rnga rol bcas/ hūm̐ dpal ldan mgon po nag po che/ /zhal bzhi phyag bzhi dur khrod chas/ /mtshon cha 'dzin cing rigs 'khor can/ /dam rdzas bzhes la phrin las mdzod/ /rnga rol bzhag rang nyid kye rdo rjer gsal ba'i snying pad dmar dang glo ba pad dkar kha sbyor nang zla dkyil la bla ma mi bskyod pa sngon po longs spyod rdzogs sku zhal gcig phyag gnyis bdud 'dul mnyam gzhag spyan gnyis zim bur gzigs shing / zhal 'dzum rol pa'i thor cog nag po lhag ma g.yas g.yon nas 'phyang ba/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar zla dkyil la hūm̐ sngon po/ de'i 'od kyi skyabs gnas thams cad spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrub dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas hūm̐ las bdud rtsi dkar po babs/ bla ma'i sku gang / bdag la mi dgos pa sogs dam tshig nyams chag dag dgyes pa'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ padma kha sbyor gyi nang gang / sdig sgrib nad gdon dag lus sems bde bas khyab/ chos skyong gi 'khu ldog zhi/ snang ba bde chen du gyur zhes brjod nas/ dmigs pa de dang ma bral bar/ he ru ka'i yig brgya ci nus/ he ru ka'i gnas su tsa turmu kha bcug pa'i yig brgya ci nus bzlas mthar thal sbyar gyis/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /sogs bshags sdom gyi tshig spyi 'gre/ bla ma mi bskyod pa 'od du zhu/ rang gi snying khar thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ bum rdzas dmigs gsal btab pa'i bum par/

dung chos rdor gzungs gang yang mi dgos pas nang gi chu dang rdzas byin rlob kyi sngags/ oṃ bi shuddhe swā bhā wā bi shuddho3haṃ swāhā/ ci 'grub bzlas nas/ rten dang mchod gtor la/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs khrus spyi 'gre/ sku phyis bcas/ slar yang ku shas bum chu gtor la gong gi sngags ci rigs bzla/ nag po chen po sogs kyis thun gtor phul/ srid zhi dpal 'byor sogs/ yig brgya bzod gsol/ brten bzhugs/ gshegs gsol go bgo bsngo smon/ shis brjod/ skabs thob gang dgos gnang bas don tshang lags/ zhes 'on chos lding rgyal sras sprul sku rin po che skal bzang thub bstan 'jigs med rgya mtsho'i bzhed skong du sa skya pa kun blos rje bla ma'i gdan sa bkra shis chos sde'i gzims chung byin can du bkod pa dge/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 kun dga' blo gros/ 'on rgyal sras rin po che'i ngor mdzad dam tshig bskang gso'i reg zig PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
